name: Neurotoxin Arrow silences its target via a native direct trigger (#3735)
contract: 500071 'Neurotoxin Arrow' reads 'Shoot ... dealing ... Nature damage and silencing them ...'. Effect 0 is SPELL_EFFECT_SCHOOL_DAMAGE and effect 1 is SPELL_EFFECT_TRIGGER_SPELL (64, a direct cast-time trigger, not a proc) firing 500616 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_SILENCE, DurationIndex 36 = 1000 ms) unconditionally at hit via the generic Spell::EffectTriggerSpell dispatch (SpellEffects.cpp); no spell_proc dependency, no script needed. CasterAuraSpell 804329 (SPELL_ADVANTAGE) gates the cast on at least one stack of Advantage, and EquippedItemClass 2/EquippedItemSubClassMask 262148 (bits 2 and 18, Bow among them) requires a ranged weapon in the ranged slot -- item 2504 'Worn Shortbow' (item_template: class 2, subclass 2 Bow) is the same fixture item the existing ranger-superb-shot-auto-shot-focus.json scenario equips at slot 17. 500071 has a 5-30 yd range (min range 5 yd); the fixture creature needs an explicit distance (default is 0, inside the minimum range, which fails the cast with SPELL_FAILED_TOO_CLOSE/128 before the silence is ever applied).

steps.label: Grant one stack of Advantage so the cast is not rejected
baseline: the target carries no silence yet
